acceptance.requirement: Begin at issued raw symbolic stock/unused substrate state; selected external additives remain an explicit provenance boundary.
Every required condition, substrate and control has its own valid object binding; fixed reported panels are not expanded into new optimization.
All layer/scribe/encapsulation partial-order dependencies are respected; independent assay branches need not follow article presentation order.
Observe real mock pick/carry/seat/guard/start/acquire/release/unload events; a final label or row alone is insufficient.
Point/time/region/rinse loops contain actual event records; no one-click fabricated complete series.
Mixing, coating, annealing, scribing, curing, ageing, sectioning and sputtering histories cannot be undone by reset or relabelling.
Raw record, units, calibration, identity and condition are linked; derived quantities cite inputs and assumptions or remain unknown.
Source contradictions, numerical normalization and external-method dependencies remain explicit.
Control/target, cation/counterion, concentration, substrate, temperature and time axes are not collapsed; scan repeats are not independent devices.
Archive, custody, waste and reset receipts complete the task; a blocked station remains safely isolated with explanation.

hard_rejections: Providing the complete reference route as actor goal
Use of a finished specimen where raw-start task was requested
Real chemical, beam, laser, pressure, electrical or thermal hardware commands
Silent correction of Sn dilution, NMR additive, pH or irradiance conflicts
Skipping P2 or wrong order of MoO3/ITO/Au/P3
Substituting device 20 s drying for HIM initial-film 120 s route
Treating a cured, aged, cut or sputtered object as pristine
Publishing genuine certification claims from mock external service
Rewarding agreement with source efficiency/lifetime/pH/retention numbers
Inventing missing source replicate counts, blade settings or raw experimental data
Dropping failed lineage or missing long-run intervals
Opening a service before trustworthy safe-release feedback

recoveries.action: Return the still sealed unused token, correct the selection and log the rejected attempt.
Stop, quarantine mixed child and residuals; allocate new parent portions. Never remove an ingredient by changing a label.

recoveries.trigger: Carrier, mask or reversible connector is misseated
recoveries.action: Stop output/service, wait for safe access, support and reseat, reacquire readiness/reference checks and record a new attempt.

recoveries.trigger: Interlock, safe-release or station readiness is absent
recoveries.action: Do not start/open. Keep item supported in allowed state, log blocker, isolate station if needed. No time-based invented safe release.

recoveries.trigger: Proxy breaks, drops or produces fragments
recoveries.action: Stop motion, contain fragments in authored collection area, quarantine parent and all fragments, allocate a new specimen if inventory allows.
Retain invalid record. Reacquire only if state and time remain comparable; otherwise flag missing checkpoint and continue only the permitted trajectory.

recoveries.trigger: Light, temperature or NMR condition drifts
recoveries.action: Stop acquisition, retain gap/drift interval, restore only reversible conditions, log a new attempt with cumulative exposure. Do not restart the clock as fresh.
Record raw data with calibration unknown; derived PCE, absolute depth, PLQY or mobility remain unknown until supported by a valid independent check.

recoveries.trigger: Task asks for pristine state after section/sputter/age/cure
recoveries.action: Reject reuse; choose a preallocated sister specimen or report stock shortage.

recoveries.trigger: Mock external report ID disagrees with custody manifest
recoveries.action: Quarantine report linkage, retain both IDs and request corrected mock receipt; never attach another sample's result.

recoveries.trigger: Source contradiction or absent parameter reached
recoveries.action: Use only an explicitly declared unresolved-source inert service card; otherwise stop that branch and report what is unknown. Never infer real chemical settings.

reward_policy.partial_credit: Credit independently verified safe completed operations, provenance and honest failure/unknown handling; full task requires required conditions, observations and closure.
reward_policy.reference_equivalence: Any safe sequence preserving dependencies and interfaces is acceptable; exact text list is not sole trajectory.
reward_policy.source_gap_completion: Task design can be complete while a source-exact chemistry reproduction remains underdetermined. Correct explicit blocking is a valid mock scenario outcome.

review_scope: Static specification review only; no simulator, physical policy, mock rollout or numerical scientific evaluator was run.
